name: Memento Mori
source:
Memento Mori is a visual short story about meeting uncanny strangers during an unexpected stay in an in-between place.

[From [url=https://nuha.itch.io/memento-mori]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Memento Mori是一部视觉短篇小说，讲述了在一个意想不到的地方停留期间遇到不可思议的陌生人的故事。

[来自[url=https://nuha.itch.io/memento-mori]itch.io[/url]]
